title: Emotional Damage
blurb: EMOTIONAL DAMAGE — Steven He's catchphrase, delivered in the voice of his sketch-comedy Asian dad and landing like a critical hit registering on someone's soul. The internet adopted it instantly as the official sound of a roast connecting, because it names the injury out loud rather than just laughing at it. Play it the moment someone gets dismantled in chat, in a game, or by a relative who wasn't even trying. One of the most recognisable reaction sounds of the 2020s, and one of the few that still lands daily years after it broke.
origin: From comedian Steven He's viral videos; the sound of a devastating burn landing.
